title: Replay playback state diagram
description: Playback of a finished game on a GameScreen in mode "replay". The position is cursor: how many transcript entries (start, moves, chat, offers, the end) have happened; _seek(n) shows the board after them and highlights them in the transcript. Play shows the entries one by one, waiting as long as the players took between them divided by the pace (1×, 4× or 16×), but between 0.35 and 3 seconds. The mode itself is fixed when the screen is made; leaving the screen is the screen navigation's business.

states.description: _playing = false; the button reads Play. _ready() starts here at cursor 0, the start position.
_playing = true; the button reads Pause, and _process counts _play_timer down.

transitions.action: If the cursor is at the end, _seek(0) first; _play_timer = _wait_before(cursor).

transitions.guard: the cursor is at the end

transitions.trigger: Start, Back, Next, End, the slider, or a move clicked in the transcript
transitions.action: _stop_and_seek(n): _seek to n, clamped to the transcript.
